patch_description: Redesign the ansatz block with two-stage entanglement: (1) RY+RZ rotations for full single-qubit control, (2) ring CZ entanglement (even pairs + odd pairs + wrap), (3) second RY rotation layer to process entangled state, (4) cross CZ entanglement for long-range connections (0-4, 1-5, 2-6, 3-7), (5) final RZ for phase. This gives better connectivity and two rounds of rotation-entanglement interaction compared to the current linear chain.
